description: Gather facts on processes listening on TCP and UDP ports using the netstat or ss commands.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Override which command to use for fetching listen ports. By default module uses first found supported command on the system (in alphanumerical order). Choices: "netstat" "ss"

parameters.name: include_non_listening
parameters.description: Show both listening and non-listening sockets (for TCP this means established connections). Adds the return values ansible_facts.tcp_listen[].state, ansible_facts.udp_listen[].state, ansible_facts.tcp_listen[].foreign_address, and ansible_facts.udp_listen[].foreign_address to the returned facts. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Gather facts on listening ports
  community.general.listen_ports_facts:

- name: TCP whitelist violation
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: TCP port {{ item.port }} by pid {{ item.pid }} violates the whitelist
  vars:
    tcp_listen_violations: "{{ ansible_facts.tcp_listen | selectattr('port', 'in', tcp_whitelist) | list }}"
    tcp_whitelist:
      - 22
      - 25
  loop: "{{ tcp_listen_violations }}"

- name: List TCP ports
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ ansible_facts.tcp_listen | map(attribute='port') | sort | list }}"

- name: List UDP ports
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ ansible_facts.udp_listen | map(attribute='port') | sort | list }}"

- name: List all ports
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ (ansible_facts.tcp_listen + ansible_facts.udp_listen) | map(attribute='port') | unique | sort | list }}"

- name: Gather facts on all ports and override which command to use
  community.general.listen_ports_facts:
    command: 'netstat'
    include_non_listening: true

return_values.name: tcp_listen
return_values.description: A list of processes that are listening on a TCP port. Returned: if TCP servers were found

return_values.name: address
return_values.description: The address the server is listening on. Returned: always Sample: "0.0.0.0"

return_values.name: foreign_address
return_values.description: The address of the remote end of the socket. Returned: if include_non_listening=true Sample: "10.80.0.1"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the listening process. Returned: if user permissions allow Sample: "mysqld"

return_values.name: pid
return_values.description: The pid of the listening process. Returned: always Sample: 1223

return_values.name: port
return_values.description: The port the server is listening on. Returned: always Sample: 3306

return_values.name: protocol
return_values.description: The network protocol of the server. Returned: always Sample: "tcp"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: The state of the socket. Returned: if include_non_listening=true Sample: "ESTABLISHED"

return_values.name: stime
return_values.description: The start time of the listening process. Returned: always Sample: "Thu Feb 2 13:29:45 2017"

return_values.name: user
return_values.description: The user who is running the listening process. Returned: always Sample: "mysql"

return_values.name: udp_listen
return_values.description: A list of processes that are listening on a UDP port. Returned: if UDP servers were found
